purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find the approximate time and place of Julio's fall.
activities.modelFrench: Mardi, vers dix heures quinze, Julio se trouvait au bord du toit près de l’échelle coulissante.
activities.modelEnglish: On Tuesday, at a quarter past ten, Julio was at the roof edge and was going down to the extension ladder.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the incident report in French.
Listen and identify the French term for ankle.
Type 'What time exactly did it happen?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: À quelle heure exactement est-ce arrivé ?
activities.modelEnglish: What time exactly did it happen?

activities.cueEnglish: Tell the supervisor an accident occurred.
activities.modelFrench: Je vous informe qu’un accident s’est produit.
activities.modelEnglish: I'm informing you that we had an accident.

activities.cueEnglish: Write the time range Rogelio gives the supervisor.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Je ne connais pas l’heure exacte; je l’estime entre dix heures quinze et dix heures vingt. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: I don't know the exact time, but it was between a quarter past ten and twenty past ten.

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the bundle landed relative to the pedestrian.
activities.modelFrench: Il a atterri sur le trottoir, à deux pas d’un voisin qui promenait son chien.
activities.modelEnglish: The bundle fell on the sidewalk, two steps from a neighbor who was walking his dog.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the near-miss in French.
Listen and identify the French term for sidewalk.
Type 'What can we change so it doesn't happen again?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Que pouvons-nous changer pour éviter que cela se reproduise ?
activities.modelEnglish: What can we change so it doesn't happen again?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the pedestrian whether he is all right.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Je suis désolé de cette frayeur, monsieur; allez-vous bien ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Sorry for the scare, sir; are you all right?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Kevin says about the stack of bundles.
activities.modelFrench: Kevin : « J’avais laissé la pile sans dispositif de retenue parce que je pensais revenir tout de suite. »
activities.modelEnglish: Kevin: I left the stack of bundles without the toe board, because it was only going to be for a moment.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what Rogelio sees on the radar at half past one.
activities.modelFrench: Vers treize heures trente, Rogelio a consulté le radar et vu une cellule orageuse à environ vingt miles.
activities.modelEnglish: At half past one, Rogelio checked the radar on his phone and saw a storm cell about 20 miles away.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the storm cell in French.
Listen and identify the French term for gust.
Answer the radio call and say you are heading down.
activities.modelFrench: Julio : « Bien reçu, je descends; je confirmerai l’état de la protection une fois en sécurité. »
activities.modelEnglish: Julio: Copy, heading down; I'll confirm the protection's condition once safe.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Rogelio tells the homeowner from a safe place.
activities.modelFrench: Depuis un lieu sûr, Rogelio a appelé la propriétaire : « Nous avons arrêté les travaux à cause de la météo; je confirmerai l’état de la toiture après inspection sûre. »
activities.modelEnglish: From a safe place Rogelio called the homeowner: We stopped for weather; I'll confirm the roof's condition after a safe inspection.
